verify-all.description: Runs complete static verification (gdcheck.py), domain AST invariants (lint_invariants.py), scene graphs (tscn_linter.py), and database schema verification (validate_schemas.py)
verify-all.command: python3 tools/gdcheck.py && python3 tools/lint_invariants.py && python3 tools/tscn_linter.py && python3 tools/validate_schemas.py || python tools/gdcheck.py && python tools/lint_invariants.py && python tools/tscn_linter.py && python tools/validate_schemas.py || py -3 tools/gdcheck.py && py -3 tools/lint_invariants.py && py -3 tools/tscn_linter.py && py -3 tools/validate_schemas.py

lint-invariants.description: Executes domain AST invariant linter (tools/lint_invariants.py) to assert layer separation, zero allocations, and choke point contracts
lint-invariants.command: python3 tools/lint_invariants.py || python tools/lint_invariants.py || py -3 tools/lint_invariants.py

eval-sim.description: Runs 60-second headless simulation assertion harness (tools/eval_simulation.py) asserting zero runtime invariant violations
eval-sim.command: python3 tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60 || python tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60 || py -3 tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60

fuzz-solvers.description: Executes 100,000 property fuzzing iterations across kinematic solvers and boundary functions (tools/fuzz_solvers.py)
fuzz-solvers.command: python3 tools/fuzz_solvers.py || python tools/fuzz_solvers.py || py -3 tools/fuzz_solvers.py

formation-audit.description: Renders terminal ASCII formation spacing diagrams across tactical phases (tools/formation_ascii.py)
formation-audit.command: python3 tools/formation_ascii.py --all || python tools/formation_ascii.py --all || py -3 tools/formation_ascii.py --all

blast-radius.description: Calculates dependency DAG blast radius for a target file (tools/dump_dep_graph.py --blast-radius <target>)

dump-dep-graph.description: Scans all GDScript files and regenerates docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json static dependency DAG
dump-dep-graph.command: python3 tools/dump_dep_graph.py || python tools/dump_dep_graph.py || py -3 tools/dump_dep_graph.py

verify.description: Executes static GDScript checker (tools/gdcheck.py) and streams stdout/stderr
verify.command: python3 tools/gdcheck.py || python tools/gdcheck.py || py -3 tools/gdcheck.py

sync-rules.description: Parses structured logs in AGENTS_ERRATA.md and promotes pending rules into .claude/rules/ and docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md
sync-rules.command: python3 tools/sync_rules.py || python tools/sync_rules.py || py -3 tools/sync_rules.py

compact-errata.description: Promotes pending rules, compacts session_state to last 3 entries, and archives history to docs/archive/errata_history.md
compact-errata.command: python3 tools/compact_errata.py || python tools/compact_errata.py || py -3 tools/compact_errata.py

rebuild-api.description: Regenerates docs/API_SURFACE.md across all 5 simulation layers from project GDScript sources
rebuild-api.command: python3 tools/dump_api.py || python tools/dump_api.py || py -3 tools/dump_api.py

next-task.description: Reads ROADMAP.md, finds the next unchecked item in 'PHASE 1 — Gameplay Completeness', and loads relevant file contexts
next-task.command: python3 tools/next_task.py || python tools/next_task.py || py -3 tools/next_task.py

layer-ctx.description: Extracts targeted layer context (rules, choke points, key files) for simulation layers 1-5
layer-ctx.command: python3 tools/layer_context.py || python tools/layer_context.py || py -3 tools/layer_context.py
